description: Knowledge base for section-Review of the Water Licence Application. Covers how to review the application, resolve outstanding issues, and the final submission lock warning.

knowledge_items.title: All Issues Must Be Resolved Before Proceeding
knowledge_items.content: Before continuing with the application, all outstanding issues must be resolved. Errors are dynamically generated by the system. The application cannot proceed until all outstanding issues are fixed.

knowledge_items.title: How to Review the Application
knowledge_items.content: To review the application: (1) Click the Application Form link to view a PDF copy of your application. (2) Review the form carefully to ensure all required information has been provided. (3) Verify that all information is accurate and true. (4) If changes are required, return to previous steps and edit your information. (5) Once review is complete, click Next to continue the submission process.

knowledge_items.title: Application Is Locked After Proceeding
knowledge_items.content: Once you proceed to the next page, your application will be locked and cannot be edited.
